data: Is the blue line lower than the red line at Epoch 6 in the bottom plot?

The bottom plot shows the expected SIMILE cost when training with BLEU and SIMILE. At Epoch 6, the blue line represents the cost of training with BLEU, while the red line represents the cost of training with SIMILE. The blue line is higher than the red line at this point. Therefore, the answer is no, the blue line is not lower than the red line at Epoch 6 in the bottom plot.
